items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: They did, on Corinth [Corinthian Records] I think, they bought the masters and put it out... I played them a little of it

ctx.x: I think Jo and Paul Weston put it out themselves right?
They did, on Corinth [Corinthian Records] I think, they bought the masters and put it out, I guess they liked that record.
